channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Former atheist neurosurgeon gives ‘case for existence of the soul’ in talk at Cornell
item.description: Professor of neurosurgery details unexplainable phenomena regarding mind-brain relationship during recent Cornell University guest lecture.

item.title: Kent State U. professor caught on camera: ‘They want to keep the white men in power’
item.description: The five-minute edited video released by AIM shows a professor discussing how DEI is still a valued ideology in some classrooms.

item.title: Elementary teacher who identifies as ‘transgender wolf’ fired after complaint letter
item.description: An elementary school teacher in North Carolina, who identified as a "trans wolf," was fired after complaints from parents regarding inappropriate behavior. The teacher allegedly told students he transforms into a wolf at night and dressed in provocative attire. Concerns about the teacher's impact on young children prompted the intervention of the Liberty Counsel.

item.title: Survey: 1 in 4 Jewish students say they’ve been excluded from campus activities
item.description: A new survey reveals that 25% of Jewish college students feel excluded from campus activities due to their identity.

item.title: Emory U. student trashes U.S. while studying in Germany: ICE is like the Gestapo
item.description: Emory University student Josselyn St. Clair, studying in Germany, draws parallels between Trump's ICE and the Gestapo, fearing for her neighbors' safety in the U.S. She expresses frustration over Berliners' views on America's erosion of rights but finds renewed patriotism in those challenging the Trump administration, altering her perception of Americans.

item.title: At DOE request, over 30 colleges sever relationship with allegedly race-exclusionary nonprofit
item.description: The Department of Education's investigations into The PhD Project's race-exclusionary practices led to over 30 universities severing ties with the nonprofit. DOE Secretary McMahon emphasized this decision reinforces equal opportunity in education, as institutions review partnerships for compliance with Title VI regulations. Negotiations continue with additional universities regarding similar issues.

item.title: Coastal Carolina CC professor fired after calling Kirk, TPUSA ‘racist pieces of sh*t’ in class
item.description: A Coastal Carolina CC psychology professor, Chris Schulte, was fired after being secretly recorded calling Charlie Kirk and Turning Point USA "racist piece[s] of sh*t." Schulte expressed concerns over rising fascism and academic freedom while facing backlash. He cited threats against him following his comments and emphasized the importance of First Amendment protections.

item.title: UNC-Chapel Hill cuts all six area research centers, drawing faculty pushback
item.description: ​The University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill will shutter six internationally focused academic centers as part of a broader cost-cutting initiative approved by the UNC Board of Trustees. item.title: Supreme Court petitioned to decide if chilling faculty speech violates First Amendment
item.description: The request to the high court comes after the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit in October upheld the dismissal of the case.

item.title: Iranian students defy crackdown as new wave of anti-government protests launch
item.description: The protests have reportedly taken place on at least seven campuses as students demand increased political freedom.
